name: Les Ombres de Dry Creek
source:
After a long absence, Silas Reed returns to Dry Creek… but something is wrong.

The silence is too heavy, the streets too empty. No explanation awaits him.

In this isolated western town, everything feels frozen in time. Familiar landmarks have vanished, the streets are deserted, and an unsettling sense of unease slowly takes hold.

What was meant to be a simple return home quickly turns into a disturbing mystery, where each moment deepens the feeling that something is fundamentally wrong in Dry Creek.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4840230/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阔别多年后，塞拉斯·里德回到了干溪……但出了什么问题。

寂静太沉重，街道太空旷。没有任何解释等待着他。

在这个偏僻的西部小镇，一切都感觉被时间冻结了。熟悉的地标消失了，街道空无一人，一种令人不安的不安感慢慢占据上风。

原本简单的回家很快就变成了一个令人不安的谜团，每时每刻都加深了一种感觉：干溪有什么根本性的问题。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4840230/]Steam[/url]]
